mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, source, `cursor`, last_sync_time, status, error_summary, create_time, update_time, version FROM crm_org_sync_cursor WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source = #{source}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_org_sync_cursor ( id, tenant_id, source, `cursor`, last_sync_time, status, error_summary, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{source}, #{cursor}, #{lastSyncTime}, #{status}, #{errorSummary}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_org_sync_cursor SET `cursor` = #{cursor}, last_sync_time = #{lastSyncTime}, status = #{status}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version}
